- US DST rolled forward on Mar 8 this year; Europe shifts at the end of March (Mar 29). Between Mar 8 and Mar 29 the US/EU offset is different by one hour compared to late April. If any US-based participants join, we'll see a temporary 1-hour shift in local times during that window.
- To keep things simple, I suggest we pick times in UTC for the invite and show local equivalents in the description.

Who from Redwood will join: Marcus Lin (Solutions Engineer) to walk the runtime and Vivek Kulkarni (EMEA AE) to cover contract/next steps. Marcus can take the technical deep-dive and handle latency/cost Qs.

Our availability (UTC):
- Tue Mar 30: 09:00–12:00 UTC
- Wed Mar 31: 14:00–17:00 UTC (but we noted your Easter bank holidays — if folks are OOO on Mar 30/31 we should avoid)
- Tue Apr 6: 08:00–11:00 UTC

If Mar 30 is risky because of EMEA bank holidays, let's tentatively aim for Apr 6 and keep Mar 30 as backup. I'll loop Marcus and Vivek on the next message and attach a quick conversion table.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
